cohort: The study included 24 primiparous women who underwent cesarean delivery and 72 who had a normal birth, all measured 50-70 days postpartum.
finding: Pelvic floor muscle strength does not differ between primiparous women based on the type of delivery, but was greater in those with higher education who performed perineal exercise during pregnancy.
mod_finding: Pelvic floor muscle strength did not significantly differ between primiparous women after normal birth and cesarean section.
